title.narrative: Technical cooperation FATF – FSRBs global network. Assignment under the framework agreement with Ministry of Justice

description.narrative:
The project will contribute to the prevention and fighting of money laundering and terrorist financing, in line with the FATF standards (Financial Action Task Force).
The Ministry of Justice will contribute technically, and facilitate and coordinate technical contributions from other relevant Norwegian public institutions, to strengthening the global network of FATF, consisting of 9 FSRBs (FATF Style Regional Bodies). This involves participation in Mutual Evaluation teams of developing countries' fulfilment of the FATF standards, and substantial contributions in the Global Network Coordination Group (GNCG) of the FATF, and to FSRBs' work (primarily ESAAMLG covering Eastern and Southern Africa), and possibly in the Joint Group for Africa.
